_comment: Experimental mixed-precision opponent policy P (task T0030, docs/P_MIXED_PRECISION.md). Profiles mirror fusion/precision.py PROFILES (tests/test_precision.py keeps them equal). Nothing here is a default of any bot: carriers select reference16 (the existing INT16 export) unless built with PONLY_PRECISION=1 and PONLY_PRECISION_ROUTE=1. No training, export, timing or game has been run with these settings.

calibration.statistic: per-input second moment E[x^2] of every layer input (raw integers for first layers, 0..128 activations for hidden layers)

distillation.loss: alpha * CE(recorded label) + (1 - alpha) * tau^2 * KL(teacher_tau || student / tau), per head (joint, act and target at the recorded moves)
distillation.status: starting values to validate later; not tuned
